system.description:
• Trained in the Tanatharen Woods under Sihnora — a sentient tree, Protector of the Tanatharen Woods and guardian of all its denizens. Sihnora cannot be communicated with by outsiders without a Druid's interpretation. Druids of this circle are among the rare few who can speak directly with him, and their training carries the weight of an ancient being who has watched the forest grow for centuries.
  • Voice of the Grove: Advantage on Language of the Wilderlands checks involving trees and plant life, and gain one extra use of Wild Shape per day.
  • Ancient Communion: Advantage on any check involving communing with, identifying, or negotiating with ancient or sentient plant life.
